supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The ridge extends laterally well beyond the 2D bounding width of the outer ocular margins.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-pigmented lower muzzle and the dark-toned periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderate vertical thickness with a slight structural droop of the lower lip in a neutral state.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dense, light-colored (greyish-white) beard across the lower muzzle and chin area.
